subject: error while running with basic script

messages.author: 2569fd2cad12d66b
messages.subject: error while running with basic script
parts:
Hi,

I have downloaded and installed rmr package using (https://github.com/
RevolutionAnalytics/RHadoop/wiki/rmr) , I have used the code from
(https://github.com/jeffreybreen/hadoop-R/blob/master/airline/src/
deptdelay_by_month/R/rmr/deptdelay-rmr.R) and tried running the
script. I am seeing the below error.

[root@01HW044544 rhadoop]# ./firstrmr.R
Loading required package: methods
Loading required package: RJSONIO
Loading required package: itertools
Loading required package: iterators
Loading required package: digest
Error in mapreduce(input = input, output = output, textinputformat =
csvtextinputformat, :
unused argument(s) (textinputformat = csvtextinputformat)
Calls: from.dfs -> to.dfs.path -> deptdelay -> mapreduce
Execution halted


I am new to this package , any help would be greatly appreciable.

Thanks
Sandeep

parts: The name of the parameter (textinputformat) has changed, you should use: mapreduce(input = input, output = output, input.format = csvtextinputformat, ...

messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: error while running with basic script
parts:
Actually input.format = "csv" should do when your csv format is readable by read.table at defaults, otherwise
input.format = make.input.format("csv", .....) where in ... one can provide read.table-like options such as sep, quote etc


Antonio
